cross_fit.missing_clock_rows: have no cross-fit value (the v6 fallback is a January-November refit, in-sample on 2025); they enter the residual training only through the four development months' fold tables, as today
cross_fit.population_note: the same population and counts as the shipped v7 (v23's learners used it too); the cross-fit v7 is a nine-month model, weaker than the twelve-month refit that ships
cross_fit.v9_from_cross_fit: v9 = max(cross-fit v7, floor) on clock-present rows; the LIRF mixture only touches missing-clock population rows and is unaffected
cross_fit.what: v7's twelve clock-present components (cat_combined 5,971 and lgb_combined 1,612 rounds; ten airport LightGBMs at the frozen counts of configs/surface_refit_v1.json; NM-residual targets; frozen 276 predictors; seed 20260913) fitted on the v23 twelve-month population (frozen January-November refit rows 1,919,370 + December build 165,677) minus the fold's three months, predicting every clock-present departure of those three months. No early stopping, no held-out label read for fitting.
cross_fit.workers: arcw0-arcw3 (one fold each, deallocated after mirroring); the twelve-month refit (--fold refit) on arcw0 only if a candidate is selected

development_baseline.name: v21 recipe development predictions
development_baseline.recipe: v9 (fold) + 1.0 * v12 development residual on matched rows outside LIRF, then 0.3 * that + 0.7 * ens_v20_bag_q_all on every row outside LIRF, then 0.15 * v9 + 0.85 * ens_v22_lirf_q on matched LIRF non-population rows with ordinary clocks, floored: the v22 selection's lirf_q_85 on January/July/November (runs/adsb_v22_v1/selection.json) and the v20-recipe December read (docs/december/score_adsb_v22_v1.json, the v19 export's residual booster applied to December). The tool refuses to run if these do not reproduce.

configuration.development_scheme: Leave-one-month-out over the four development months. For a held-out month every residual variant is fitted on its declared training rows from the other months; candidates are scored on ALL rows of the held-out month (every label, no clipping) against the incumbent's development prediction. The development months' v9 comes from the frozen folds (scratch/seasonal, scratch/forward: seasonal fold for January/July, forward fold for November; scratch/december: the January-November refit) or, where a candidate says cross_fit, from the cross-fitted v7 on clock-present rows (missing-clock rows and the LIRF fill population always keep the fold value). The blend tables on the development months are the incumbent's out-of-sample fold predictions (January/July/November) and the cached January-November refit leaves (December), identical for baseline and candidates.

prior_evidence.closed_levers: committee growth, blend weights, residual seed bag and scale, calibration, v19 surface features, test-time adaptation, arrival context, geometry, OPDI, other ADS-B networks (docs/adsb_v20, docs/audit_20260918, docs/tta_screen, docs/opdi)
prior_evidence.learning_curve: docs/adsb_v24/learning_curve.json (tools/residual_learning_curve.py; the December-held-out series completed before this declaration, the January/July/November series were still running and are recorded with the selection): on December held out, the residual trained on November alone lowers the non-LIRF blend RMSE by 3.03%, on July alone 1.90%, January alone 2.22%, July+November 3.00%, January+November 3.21%, January+July 2.61%, all three 3.26%; the three-month set subsampled to one month's rows gives 2.63-2.74%. Reading: adjacent months matter most, off-season months add little, and rows still help (3.5x rows within the same mix: -0.65% blend). The ranking's July half currently has one summer month (July 2025) behind the residual; June and August 2025 are its adjacent months and are only reachable through cross-fitting.
prior_evidence.v7_month_value: docs/adsb_v24/v7_month_value.json (tools/v7_month_value.py): on December's clock-present departures the v7 forward-fold components (January-September) score 199.83, the seasonal-fold components 202.98, the January-November refit 196.58 (-1.63% / -3.15%): v7 responds to adjacent months like the learners did (docs/december/month_value.json), most at LIRF (306 -> 296) and LTFM (211 -> 207), where v9 carries full or large weight.

configuration.purpose: Two levers that the v21 stack leaves on the table, developed on the four labelled development months (January, July, November, December 2025) and shipped through a twelve-month refit: (1) the v12 residual stage trained on all twelve months of 2025 instead of the four months that had an out-of-sample v9, made possible by cross-fitting v7's twelve timeline components in four month-group folds; (2) v7 itself refit on twelve months (the same recipe and counts, December added, like v23 did for the learners). Two bounded scans ride along: the residual on the newer 1,332-stand match tables, and a low-weight blend of the LIRF learner table on unmatched LIRF rows.

residual_model.applies_to: v12's residual model (nb feature set, matched rows outside LIRF, weight 1.0, single booster, unchanged parameters and inner rounds rule); the nb_season feature set adds season_cos = cos(2*pi*(day_of_year-1)/365.25) (1 at New Year, -1 at the start of July), a label-free calendar feature so a twelve-month model can keep the season-matched behaviour the four-month model has implicitly
residual_model.blend: post-hoc convex combination with the extra table adsb_full (candidate_values in tools/run_adsb_v11.py); a NaN learner value leaves the row unblended
residual_model.prediction: v9 + weight * residual on in-scope rows, then floor
residual_model.rounds_rule: development: rounds per held-out month and variant (scope, feature set) come from a 5-fold day-grouped inner split of the two training months (median best iteration, 200 rounds patience, at most 4000); the held-out month is never used for rounds; export: median of the selected variant's three development round counts

scopes.all_no_lirf: every departure at any airport except LIRF: a blend scope only (unmatched rows there become (1 - w) * v9 + w * adsb_full)
scopes.lirf_nonpop: every LIRF departure outside the v9 mixture's fill population (airport == LIRF and not population): a blend scope only; rows there are (1 - w) * v9 + w * <table>, the population rows stay v9
scopes.lirf_nonpop_matched: LIRF departures outside the fill population with a matched ADS-B surface segment (adsb_matched == 1) whose NM proxy and schedule interval are both under six hours in absolute value (label-free, available on the ranking rows): the LIRF blend scope after the amendment; every other LIRF row stays v9
scopes.matched_no_lirf: departures with a matched ADS-B surface segment at any airport except LIRF (adsb_matched == 1 and airport != LIRF): the residual model's training and prediction scope (exactly v12)

residual_model.seed_bag: none: v21_v1 measured the five-seed bag at -0.002% on every month (runs/adsb_v21_v1/selection.json, candidate ens_v20_bag_q_all_70); the residual is the single declared booster again, exactly as in v12-v20

configuration.selection: For each candidate, RMSE on each held-out development month versus the incumbent's development prediction. Eligible when not worse on ANY of the four months (ratio <= 1.0), mean ratio over the four months at most 0.9998 (0.02%), and the paired-day bootstrap interval of the RMSE difference below zero on every month where the candidate differs from the baseline on at least one row. Choose the eligible candidate with the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep v21. incumbent_repro is a check. Per-airport, ordinary-row and v9 figures are descriptive.
configuration.ship: If a candidate is selected: (a) tools/run_v7_dec.py --fold refit on arcw0 fits the twelve components on all twelve months at the frozen counts and predicts the clock-present ranking rows; missing-clock ranking rows keep the uploaded v9 (= frozen v6) exactly and the LIRF fill population keeps the uploaded v9 exactly (the mixture was validated on the frozen v7 and the development protocol never scores it on a new v7); v9 on every other clock-present row = max(twelve-month v7, -12); for candidates with v9 = fold the ranking v9 is the uploaded v9 (no v7 refit). (b) The selected residual variant is refit on ALL twelve months' declared rows (development months with the selected v9 provenance, the eight others with cross-fit v9) with rounds from the inner rule applied once; (c) blended exactly as v21 with the twelve-month ranking tables and any selected extra blend; floored; exported as vigorous-whistle_v22.parquet; verified by an independent re-implementation and audited (tools/audit_export.py); uploaded only with the user's approval; the official score against v21 (239.5766) is the final test.

rule: For each candidate, RMSE on each held-out development month versus the incumbent's development prediction. Eligible when not worse on ANY of the four months (ratio <= 1.0), mean ratio over the four months at most 0.9998 (0.02%), and the paired-day bootstrap interval of the RMSE difference below zero on every month where the candidate differs from the baseline on at least one row. Choose the eligible candidate with the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep v21. incumbent_repro is a check. Per-airport, ordinary-row and v9 figures are descriptive.
